name: outlook-mcp
description: MCP server connecting Claude to a personal Outlook account via Microsoft Graph (mail, attachments, folders, inbox rules, categories, calendar, contacts, Microsoft To Do tasks with subtasks, auto-reply, working hours and Focused-Inbox overrides, junk-sender blocking, MIME (.eml) export, delta 'what changed' checks and pushed change notifications, and two opt-in LLM features on the hosted server — injection-hardened auto-filing into existing folders and a drafted morning brief; sending only via explicit two-step draft-then-send).
